question: pi 全为 1、保留全集的确定性设计下，Hájek 估计与稠密 full-cache 输出的相对误差是否为 0？
verify:
import sys, pathlib
_root = next(p for p in map(pathlib.Path, sys.path) if (p / 'src' / 'kvblockmass').is_dir())
sys.path.insert(0, str(_root / 'src'))
import torch
from kvblockmass.certificate import error_certificate, full_cache_output, relative_error
scores = torch.linspace(-1, 1, 16, dtype=torch.float64)
values = torch.arange(64, dtype=torch.float64).reshape(16, 4) / 16.0
ones_pi = torch.ones(16, dtype=torch.float64)
all_keep = torch.ones(16, dtype=torch.bool)
cert = error_certificate(scores, values, all_keep, ones_pi, all_keep)
result = round(relative_error(cert.y_hat, full_cache_output(scores, values)), 12)
